copy.description: Tired of soggy, muddy dogs after every rainy walk? This dog raincoat, which the maker lists as waterproof, is made for wet days. The maker lists it as reflective. The coat is made of polyester and comes in sizes S, M, L, and XL. Choose the size that fits your dog, and measure before you buy, since this page does not list chest, neck, or length measurements. Each order includes one dog coat. Keep one by the door so it is ready for the next rainy walk. A snug fit matters most on a wet walk, so take a moment to check your dog's size. It is a practical option for dog parents who walk in all kinds of weather. Choose from rose red, green, or blue, each with a hook-and-loop closure.

faq.a: The coat comes in sizes S, M, L, and XL. This page gives no chest, neck, or length measurements, so measure your dog and compare before you order.
It is made of polyester. The maker lists it as waterproof and reflective.
Estimate: 5–11 days to the US after 1–3 days of processing. Ships from China.
